test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to the group is POT.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) BX – HK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e3d1855f9997d405a11022c6151a0a161d3ae75dd4eb81f727e04fa40e026be.png] 

Option 2) GC – MP 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd7846b677035281288eb39d07efc1d93a64afa170271c1dfa7b2ab836632ba1.png] 

 

**Option 3) TP – ZD**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69329c61e187f52d6448449d57e89f7f5966ea222ef40deb3e8407316fb4497e.png] 

 

Option 4) XT – DG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/525b3a7a1e5353ff7f46a30daf309fbcf313f812a93f1a90f9755e51e9c1a790.png] 

 

Thus, the letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to that group is TP – ZD.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
